=== 11 Nimmt: Two Hot Piles ===

CARDS. The deck has N cards numbered 1 to N: N = 30 with 3 players, N = 40 with 4 players. OX-HEADS. Cards 11, 22 and 33 carry 3 ox-heads. Every other multiple of 5 carries 2. All other cards carry 1.

SETUP. Shuffle once. Deal each player a private hand of H cards: H = 9 with 3 players, H = 8 with 4 players. Turn the next two cards face up: they start Pile A and Pile B, each of size 1. The rest (1 card with 3 players, 6 with 4) are set aside unseen and take no part in the game. Everyone starts with penalty 0 and bulls 0.

INFORMATION. You see only your own hand. Everyone sees both piles (their cards, top card, size and ox total), every card played and every take, and all penalties and bulls.

FITTING. A card c fits a pile with top card t if d = (c - t) mod N is between 1 and 10 inclusive. Example with N = 30: on a top of 25, the cards 26 to 30 and 1 to 5 fit; 6 and 25 do not. ROOM. A pile has room if it has fewer than 5 cards; a full pile accepts no placement. PLACEMENT. A placement is a card from your hand that fits a pile with room.

ROUNDS. The game lasts exactly H rounds. In round r the seats act one after another, starting with seat ((r - 1) mod number of players) + 1 and continuing in seat order, wrapping round. Each seat starts 3 times (3 players) or 2 times (4 players).

TURN. On your turn you choose exactly one card from your hand and one pile (A or B). If you hold at least one placement, you must choose a placement (only placements are offered): the card goes on top of that pile, the pile's size rises by 1 and its ox total rises by the card's ox. If you hold no placement at all, you must TAKE: you choose any card and either pile, and then (1) add that pile's ox total to your penalty; (2) if the pile had 3 or more cards, gain 1 bull (with fewer cards, no bull); (3) discard that pile's cards out of the game; (4) your chosen card becomes that pile's only card (size 1, ox equal to that card's). The other pile is unchanged. Every turn removes exactly one card from your hand, so all hands empty at the end of round H.

BULLS. Each bull is worth -2 at the end. Bulls are unlimited and never move between players.

END. After round H, each player's final score = penalty - 2 x bulls. Cards left in the two piles count against nobody. The lowest final score wins; players tied for lowest share the win.

CARDS. The deck has N cards numbered 1 to N: N = 30 with 3 players, N = 40 with 4 players. OX-HEADS. Cards 11, 22 and 33 carry 3 ox-heads. Every other multiple of 5 carries 2. All other cards carry 1.

The rest (1 card with 3 players, 6 with 4) are set aside unseen and take no part in the game. Everyone starts with penalty 0 and bulls 0.

INFORMATION. You see only your own hand. Everyone sees both piles (their cards, top card, size and ox total), every card played and every take, and all penalties and bulls.

A pile has room if it has fewer than 5 cards; a full pile accepts no placement. PLACEMENT. A placement is a card from your hand that fits a pile with room.

CARDS. The deck has N cards numbered 1 to N: N = 30 with 3 players, N = 40 with 4 players. OX-HEADS. Cards 11, 22 and 33 carry 3 ox-heads. Every other multiple of 5 carries 2. All other cards carry 1.

SETUP. Shuffle once. Deal each player a private hand of H cards: H = 9 with 3 players, H = 8 with 4 players. Turn the next two cards face up: they start Pile A and Pile B, each of size 1. The rest (1 card with 3 players, 6 with 4) are set aside unseen and take no part in the game. Everyone starts with penalty 0 and bulls 0.

INFORMATION. You see only your own hand. Everyone sees both piles (their cards, top card, size and ox total), every card played and every take, and all penalties and bulls.

FITTING. A card c fits a pile with top card t if d = (c - t) mod N is between 1 and 10 inclusive. Example with N = 30: on a top of 25, the cards 26 to 30 and 1 to 5 fit; 6 and 25 do not. ROOM. A pile has room if it has fewer than 5 cards; a full pile accepts no placement. PLACEMENT. A placement is a card from your hand that fits a pile with room.
